يشرئب (form IVq)
# يَشْرَئِبُّ (yašraʔibbu) /jaʃ.ra.ʔib.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِشْرَأَبَّ (išraʔabba)
# يَشْرَئِبَّ (yašraʔibba) /jaʃ.ra.ʔib.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْرَأَبَّ (išraʔabba)
# يَشْرَئِبِّ (yašraʔibbi) /jaʃ.ra.ʔib.bi/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِشْرَأَبَّ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
